newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts trade in Seamico.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts trade in Seamico.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trade in shares of Seamico Securities Plc during the afternoon session on Monday pending a corporate disclosure.

"The SET halted securities trading of Seamico Securities Plc for not longer than one trading session. The SET is waiting for the company to disclose information," the exchange said in a statement. It gave no further details.
Seamico shares last traded at 8.20 baht, down 0.80. The composite SET index had lost 16.58 points, or 2.66 percent, to 606.67 by 0821 GMT.
